q: A carmaker asks our Bekasi parts plant for carbon data. Where do we start?
title: Bekasi auto parts supplier carbon data
short: Start with electricity bills and any diesel or LPG, which make up most of a parts plant's own footprint, then add the steel, aluminium or plastic bought in, which is usually larger. Give the carmaker a figure per part or per kilogram, with the period stated.
audience: Tier 1 and tier 2 automotive suppliers in Bekasi and Karawang

ul: Electricity from the grid, at the Indonesian grid factor.
Diesel for generators and forklifts; LPG for heat treatment.

p: Steel, aluminium and resin usually outweigh the plant's own energy. Use supplier figures where you have them and stated defaults where you do not.
If one line makes parts for several customers, split by weight or machine hours and say which.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

Carbon per kg or per piece
